Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 13: the slip of [[Prophetess (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.”), word for word the text of [[Prophetess (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
